facts.fact: The Agence Nationale des Systèmes d'Information de l'État (ANSIE) issued the Cadre d'Interopérabilité de Djibouti (CID) as the national interoperability framework, setting principles, four interoperability layers (legal, organisational, semantic, technical) and a conceptual model for integrated public service delivery; the document shows no enactment date, so the published date (2022) is used.

The e-Governance Academy states it drafted the national interoperability framework for ANSIE in a government-funded project (EUR 52,800) that ran May 2022 to April 2023 and is marked finished; the page gives no adoption date.

note: Names interoperability between government administrations only as an expected means of modernising the state, with no framework named or being drafted; an aim gives no fact.
Draft claim contradicted by the issued framework held as DJI-001.
